name: JavDB v3
deviceFindingsFromTest3: The iterative Test1-Test3 UI overlays became visually heavier and less usable than Stable.
The desired product direction is explicitly the NetflxCat visual language shown in current device screenshots.
The home page should prioritize green circular shortcuts, a large search box, compact horizontal content tabs and poster content instead of explanatory sections and tool-style blocks.
The category page should use one compact horizontal filter row per dimension and immediately show posters beneath, avoiding stacked section descriptions and filter-control walls.

changes.reset: Test4 stops loading Test1/Test2/Test3 UI overlays. Only the validated 3.9.44 Local-First Base Runtime and a single UI4 overlay participate in rendering.
changes.home: Five green circular shortcuts (Filter/Ranking/Actors/Favorites/More), large search input, compact content tabs and immediate three-column poster feed.
changes.category: NetflxCat-style compact rows: content type, resource, year, sort and tag groups. Long rows intentionally use Hiker scroll_button overflow.
changes.advanced: Only one advanced tag group is edited at a time; back(true) returns to and refreshes the catalog.
changes.rank: Independent ranking page with compact type/period rows and metadata-oriented ranking cards.
changes.actor: Independent actor page with compact tabs and three-column actor cards.
changes.library: Independent local/account library page, no top-level gray control wall.
changes.more: Low-frequency tools use simple text_icon rows rather than large gray button matrices.
changes.playback: Third-party providers retain compact icons and existing Shared Playback providerUrl/resolve contracts.
